description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA. This is a permanent, full-time opportunity for a leader committed to long-term impact within a supportive environment. We are specifically looking for candidates seeking a stable, enduring role.

The ADON will play a crucial role in supporting the Director of Nursing, overseeing daily clinical operations, and ensuring the delivery of exceptional patient care. You will contribute to maintaining high standards of quality, compliance, and staff development, fostering a positive and efficient clinical setting.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa or eligible for reciprocity.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or long-term care facility.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations.
Strong clinical assessment, organizational, and communication skills.
Commitment to a permanent, full-time position.
